summary: Iteration 3: tested game one-screen layout (7 viewports), wager progress bar (Wallet/Withdraw + /api/wallet), Agent Workload admin tab + /api/admin/workload, live win feed + /api/game/state winners, and ticket alerts (user + verifier poll, toasts). New backend suite 12/12 pass; iter2 (14/14) and iter1 e2e (24/24) regressions pass. One real bug: wallets created before this feature (no wager_required field) show 0% progress forever even after betting (11 of 14 wallets with pending wagering, including player1).

minor.issue: Old wallets have wager_remaining but no wager_required. The code computes req = max(wager_required, rem), so req always equals rem and wager_done stays 0 after bets. Seen on player1: remaining 65000 and wager_required missing, so the UI shows '₹0.00 / ₹650.00 · 0%' even after a bet. 11 wallets in the DB are affected.

Name masking n[:2]+'***'+n[-1:] shows every character of a 3-letter username (e.g. 'abc' -> 'ab***c'). Also runs a db.bets status=won sort by settled_at on every 1s poll for every user. Add an index on {status:1, settled_at:-1} or cache the list.

ui_bugs.issue: main overflows by 20px (scrollHeight 342 vs clientHeight 322), so the bottom of Recent Results is clipped. The header balance is also cut short ('₹1,3...'). All other tested viewports have no overflow: 360x640, 375x667, 390x844, 412x915, 768x1024, 1920x800.

integration_issues.issue: Same root cause as the /api/wallet item: the progress bar stays at 0% for old wallets.

issues: The 'Next Round In' label (e.g. 63px wide inside a 72px circle at 1920x800, 45px inside 58px at 360x640) sits on the curved edge and touches or crosses the ring stroke. Shorten it to 'Next round' or shrink the font.
justify-evenly leaves large empty gaps between the board, result stage and recent results. Acceptable, but the space could go to bigger ODD/EVEN circles.

action_items: Migrate legacy wallets on startup: set wager_required = wager_remaining where wager_required is missing (or less than remaining) and wager_remaining > 0, so wager_done can grow when users bet
Optional: fix the 320px-height overflow on the game page (shrink the result stage clamp min or hide the sparkles)
Optional: make the countdown label fit inside the notch
Optional: stronger name masking for short usernames; add a winners index or cache
critical_code_review_comments: routes_user.wallet: req = max(wager_required, rem) hides the missing-field case; add a data migration rather than relying on max()
AlertPoller marks every unread notification (coupons, deposits, etc.) read as soon as it shows the toast. Check that the Messages page does not depend on 'read' for unread badges

Sonner toasts disappear after about 4s and the poll runs every 6s. The DB confirmed both toasts were delivered (read=true), but a user who looks away misses them. Consider a longer duration for ticket toasts
Workload: open withdrawals stay assigned to disabled agents (pv1004 disabled with 1 open withdrawal of ₹300). Consider flagging these or reassigning them automatically

success_rate.frontend: 95% (all requested flows work; legacy wager display bug)

context_for_next_testing_agent: Clear db.rate_events, then run: cd /app/backend && REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL=<url> pytest tests/test_iter3_features.py -n 0. Admin alerts are in GET /api/admin/dashboard 'alerts' (there is no /admin/alerts). Toasts use [data-sonner-toast]; poll every 500ms because toasts expire before the next 6s poll. In playwright scripts, use requests plus inline hmac TOTP to drive admin/user actions while a UI page is open.
rca of the issue: Wager progress 0% for old users: promotions.add_wagering only started incrementing wager_required in this iteration. Existing wallets have wager_remaining but no wager_required. The /wallet calculation req = max(0, rem) means done = req - rem = 0 forever, and consume_wagering only lowers remaining. Reproduce: GET /api/wallet as player1, place a bet, wager_done stays 0. Fix: one-time migration db.wallets.update_many({wager_remaining:{$gt:0}, wager_required:{$exists:false}}, [{$set:{wager_required:'$wager_remaining'}}]).
